recipes.name: One-Pot Veggie Lentil Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Once hot, add the onions and cook for 5 minutes. Add splashes of water as needed to deglaze the pot.
Add the garlic and red chilli, cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the spices and cook for 30 - 60 seconds, stirring throughout.
Add the water, bouillon, lentils, and potatoes*. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, partially covered for 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and cook for another 10 minutes.
Optionally, blend half of the soup using an immersion blender to make it more creamy. Then add the broccoli and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Adjust salt and pepper to your liking, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * When possible, we soak lentils for a few hours to shorten cooking time and enhance nutrient absorption. If unsoaked, simply extend cooking by 15 minutes and add more water. Learn more about the benefits of soaking in our PUL article.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 week, or the freezer for up to 2 months.
